item.title: EKS-optimized AL2023 NVIDIA AMI includes two NVIDIA driver versions
item.description: The EKS-optimized AL2023 NVIDIA AMI now bundles two NVIDIA driver versions in a single AMI. Each node automatically selects the appropriate driver for its GPU at boot, enabling support for the g7 instance type without building a custom AMI.

item.title: AWS managed policy updates
item.description: Added wafv2:ListWebACLs permission in AmazonEKSLoadBalancingPolicy to allow Amazon EKS Auto Mode Controller to list AWS WAF Web ACLs when reconciling Application Load Balancer associations.
